The '''Wanderer's Path''' was a road that ran through the thick vine jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. A formal rite of passage was established during the planet's history, where adolescents would accompany experienced Wanderers on expeditions out into the dense jungles.<ref name="NoP" />
